macros.name: keywords
macros.doc: The abstract also displays a short list of keywords, separated by commas, which are inserted with \keywords command.

arg.snippet: shortauthor{${1:author list for the running heads}}

macros.name: Volume
macros.doc: The volume number, e.g. “III”, has to be inserted by the user directly in Roman capital letters, using the \Volume command.

macros.name: Year
macros.doc: The year of publication of the article is then inserted with the \Year command.
